verdict.rationale: Clara documents attaching GL codes, cost centers, or project IDs to transactions via labels, and a reconciliation guide that categorizes transactions and exports them to accounting. Signed transaction webhooks and near-real-time monitoring could support coding close to the time of spend, and the marketing site claims automated expense reporting. However, the documented labeling flow is framed as a billing-period reconciliation step, not coding at the moment of spend. Missing for 10: receipt capture/matching, memo entry by cardholders, explicit coding at transaction time (merchant/category auto-coding), independent or hands-on corroboration.
